public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle widths above PostgreSQL's regex repetition limit**

When `chars` exceeds 255, this generates a pattern PostgreSQL cannot execute: for example, `wrap_label_sql("name", 300)` emits `{1,300}`, but [PostgreSQL limits regex repetition bounds to 255](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/functions-matching.html#POSIX-SYNTAX-DETAILS). Consequently, a chart using this expression fails its data query even for short labels, whereas `wrap_label` accepts the same width. Support larger widths with a different pattern construction, or explicitly validate and document the limit before returning invalid SQL.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
